name: gitsense
description: Makes sense of your repo. Free, local-first git blame, history, and insight — directly in the editor.

gitsense.blame.enabled.description: Show inline blame decorations, hover cards, and the status bar item.

gitsense.blame.format.description: Template for the inline blame text. Tokens: {author} {age} {date} {message} {sha}

gitsense.blame.highlightCurrentLine.description: Highlight the current line's blame decoration.

gitsense.blame.ignoreWhitespace.description: Pass -w to git blame to ignore whitespace-only changes.

gitsense.maxBlameFileSize.description: Skip blame for files larger than this size, in bytes.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && tsc -p . --outDir out-test && node out-test/test/integration/runTests.js
